title: Zabbix: Detect and show pre-7.0 passive agent error messages
description:
As documented in https://www.zabbix.com/documentation/6.4/en/manual/appendix/items/activepassive, pre-7.0 passive agent error messages are returned as `ZBX_NOTSUPPORTED\0Error message`.

Show `ZBX_NOTSUPPORTED\0` in `zabbix.data` and the error message in `zabbix.error`.

Sample capture with errors: [zabbixagent60-2024-05-12-1.pcap](/uploads/376fc8cab5aa658b6c2ed4b4ba388c1f/zabbixagent60-2024-05-12-1.pcap)
